name: Page Number
what_it_does: Opens a menu of page-number positions (top, bottom, margins, current position) and formats; numbers live in the header/footer stories.
behavior: Opens Page Number (menu). Contents (6 controls): Top of Page, Bottom of Page, Page Margins, Current Position, Remove Page Numbers, Format Page Numbers.... Sub-surfaces: ui:header-footer-page-number-insert-menu-top-of-page, ui:header-footer-page-number-insert-menu-bottom-of-page, ui:header-footer-page-number-insert-menu-page-margins, ui:header-footer-page-number-insert-menu-current-position, ui:header-footer-page-number-insert-menu-format-page-numbers. [flyout of subfeature:page-number-insert — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule] Appears as a page with '#' marks, labelled 'Page Number'.
